notes:
Zone ne_roads: carriageways, service drives, sidewalks, plazas, curbs and road paint of the north-east district, read from ortho2020 with LiDAR (2017) for walls and curbs in shadow and OpenStreetMap for names and walk lines.
Method: road centre lines were fitted to the painted centre line, found in colour profiles across the road every 2 m (Yogi Berra Drive and Webster Road keep within 0.2 m of one straight run per section, joined by true arcs: Yogi Berra r 65 m at the Energy Plant bend, Webster Road r 46 m north of Blanton Hall, r 80 m and r 36 m past Machuga Heights). Edges are parallel offsets of the centre line, the offset per section read from the same profiles (curb or grass edge to about 0.2-0.3 m). Sections change at junction mouths.
Yogi Berra Drive: north/west curb 4.9 m left of the centre line by the plant and the substation, grass edge 4.4 m north of the deck, 5.1 m north of Lot 23N; east curb 6.4, 6.6 and 5.9 m. Parking bay with angled stalls on the east side below Dinallo Heights (stalls not painted here).
Webster Road: west curb 5.1-5.6 m (a 5.6 m southbound lane), east curb 3.55 m with a 3.4 m walk; drop-off bay (east curb 6.75 m) in front of the Student Recreation Center; west curb in the shadow of Dinallo Heights carried on (UNVERIFIED); north of the Machuga drive the west side is 8.9 m wide with a painted edge line at 5.7 m, tapering to 5.5 m.
Footprint: Yogi Berra Drive is drawn full width to the south-west footprint edge (cut 0.5 m outside); the Webster Road bend is cut at the unchanged edge (60,468)-(90,455). No south walk or curb on Yogi Berra by the plant: asphalt meets the grass bank.
Lots, their stalls and the deck are another zone: road surfaces end at the lot mouths with a small overlap. The Lot 24 median and the Stone Street apron in front of Blanton Hall are drawn here.
Walks: road-side walks are offsets of the road centre lines; other walks follow OpenStreetMap lines shifted onto the walk and given the median width read across the ortho; corners are true arcs. Plazas in front of the Student Recreation Center read from ortho profiles; the Dinallo lobby patio is mostly hidden by roofs (UNVERIFIED).
Paint: double yellow centre lines on Yogi Berra Drive and Webster Road, Webster west edge line, Stone Street stop bar, 19 continental crosswalks (0.5 m bars, 0.6 m gaps, bar count from the crossing length). Stalls: 6 angled stalls in the Yogi Berra parking bay and 3 square stalls in the Webster pull-off (both UNVERIFIED). A solid lane line 3.9 m east of the Yogi Berra centre line by the plant (y 463-496). Not drawn: the line about 3.7 m east of the centre line further north (only broken pieces visible). Edited by hand (fix-up pass, 2020 ortho fetched again at 0.075 m/px): the CarParc Diem south drive's centre line, arrows, stop bar and word at its mouth; the Machuga drive's stop bar and word at Webster Road; the Stone Street lane line; arrows on the Dinallo drive, the Machuga east drive and Stone Street (drawn as the standard 3.0 m arrow; the painted ones read 2.0-2.7 m). Yogi Berra Drive and Webster Road themselves show no lane arrows in the ortho. The CarParc Diem yard edge was moved off the brick enclosure east of the Energy Plant (it ran 2-6 m inside it) to the edge of the bed round it.
